scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @packagetruth/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @packagetruth/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && npm run typecheck -w @packagetruth/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:core && vitest run tests/unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:core && vitest run tests/integration
